def test_install_mixed_requirements_dispatch(tmp_path, monkeypatch, prefix, custom, roles, collections):
    requirement = tmp_path / 'requirements.yml'
    requirement.write_text('roles:\\n  - example.role\\ncollections:\\n  - example.collection\\n')
    role_install = MagicMock()
    collection_install = MagicMock()
    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_roles', role_install)
    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', collection_install)
    args = ['ansible-galaxy'] + prefix + ['install', '-r', str(requirement)]
    if custom:
        args += ['-p', str(tmp_path / 'roles')]
    GalaxyCLI(args=args).run()
    assert role_install.called is roles
    assert collection_install.called is collections
    if roles:
        assert role_install.call_args[0][0][0].name == 'example.role'
    if collections:
        assert collection_install.call_args[0][0] == [('example.collection', '*', None)]


def test_install_empty_requirements(tmp_path, monkeypatch, capsys):

    requirement.write_text('roles: []\\ncollections: []\\n')

    monkeypatch.setattr(GalaxyCLI, '_install_collections', MagicMock())
    GalaxyCLI(args=['ansible-galaxy', 'install', '-r', str(requirement)]).run()
    assert 'Skipping install, no requirements found' in capsys.readouterr().out
